title: Hold a poppy licence
what: Cultivate, possess, transport or process poppy material only as a holder of a poppy licence from the Authority, or as its authorised contractor or employee.

sources.title: Poppy Regulation Act 2014 (NT)
sources.quote: Cultivation, possession, processing of poppy material A person commits an offence if: (a) the person engages in conduct related to: (i) the cultivation of a plant

sources.title: Poppy Regulation Act 2014 (NT)
sources.quote: (c) at the time the conduct is engaged in, the person is not: (i) a licensee; or (ii) a contractor of a licensee authorised under a contract to engage in the conduct

sources.title: Poppy Regulation Act 2014 (NT)
sources.locator: s 4, words naming the body (found 23 Nov 2026) (current reprint)
sources.quote: Authority means the Poppy Licensing Authority mentioned in section 15.
